title: Measurement: a custom provider's resolved compat reaches the live-check child, and the canary, the record and the started Pi make the same request
summary: TSK-0073, toward ACC-0117. IMPLEMENTATION, b267beb. customProviderConfig in lib/launch-checks.mjs now passes the model's compat as Pi resolved it, merged from the provider block, the model definition and modelOverrides. lib/pi-provider-canary.mjs accepts compat on a model entry only with fields the compatibility key knows (assertKnownCompat in lib/runtime-records.mjs), each structured field in its known shape. It refuses any credential-named key, compared whole after lowercasing and dropping separators, at any depth of an entry, including its samplingParams and compat. Every refusal comes before any child is created. apiKey, headers and authHeader stay refused as unknown properties at the provider and the model level. REAL-COMMAND CONTROL, test/custom-provider-compat.test.mjs (529e5db), against TSK-0062's loopback fixture with the provider compat {supportsStore:false, supportsUsageInStreaming:false, maxTokensField:max_tokens}. For a loopback URL, Pi's defaults would send store and stream_options and name the limit max_completion_tokens. Real setup's live check passed. Before b267beb it refused with canary-inputs-differ. The provider received one canary request with no store, no stream_options and max_tokens, and it was authorised. The compatibility record carries all three compat values. The real bin/start-kiln.mjs launch proved compatibility by that record, and the started Pi's request had the same three fields. After compat was changed in models.json, the next launch exited 2 ('taken under different conditions') and contacted the provider not at all. CREDENTIAL CONTROLS, test/pi-provider-canary.test.mjs. These configurations are refused before any child exists, with nothing named: an unknown compat field, an unknown key inside a structured compat field, a credential name in samplingParams, a credential name as a chat-template kwarg, and a token nested in samplingParams. A known compat and maxTokens are accepted. MUTATION. With compat removed from customProviderConfig, the control failed in WSL with canary-inputs-differ. CI. Run 36077139114 at 564f8a7 passed all four cells, including this control. The earlier run 36076748293 at 529e5db was red: on Windows Node 22 this control failed at its launch step with 'shutdown was not observed complete. Not observed: agent-descendants', after its canary, request-shape and record assertions had passed. That is F130's second open mechanism, a short-lived agent the Windows tracker never observes, not compat.

omissions.reason: Only a custom provider's configuration crosses to the child. A built-in provider's compat is Pi's own catalogue and is not configured by Kiln.
